blocks.text: Define a baseline REST API plus a streaming channel for realtime updates.
Fetch one coherent run snapshot, then open the metric and log stream from its resume cursor. After disconnect, reconnect from the last safely reduced cursor.

Contract checks:
- A cursor-based resume story.
- Clear separation between REST and streaming.
- Small event payloads for frequent updates.

blocks.title: Contract checkpoint
blocks.text: A simple stream with small events and a resume cursor is enough for a reliable realtime dashboard.

The snapshot returns run metadata, metric descriptors, initial samples, and resume cursor. Deltas carry immutable event identity and sequence. Historical metric queries accept time or step range and desired resolution. Components consume normalized selectors and never infer terminal lifecycle from the absence of samples.

steps.title: Resume
steps.text: Connect from the last reduced cursor and expose stale or catching-up state.

steps.title: Merge
steps.text: Apply lifecycle and series fields by sequence, ignoring duplicate events.

steps.title: Render
steps.text: Downsample to visible resolution and update accessible summaries on a restrained cadence.
